question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Something that is very small/little
solution:
The correct answer is '**Tiny**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Tiny**'.
 
• **Tiny**: very small; minute. (Hindi: बहुत छोटा) 
 
 
• *Example: The ant was so **tiny** that I could barely see it on the ground.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Tiny.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Few**: a small number of people or things; not many. (Hindi: कुछ ही) 
 
• **Thin**: having opposite surfaces or sides close together; having little thickness or depth. (Hindi: पतला)
 
• **Slender**: gracefully thin; slim. (Hindi: पतला)
